record.dic_text:
03245 yacad {ya:-sad'}

字根型; TWOT - 875; 動詞

欽定本 - foundation 15, lay 8, founded 8, ordain 2, counsel 2, established 2,
     foundation + SNH03117　1, appointed 1, instructed 1, set 1, sure 1; 42

1) 設立, 創立, 堅固
   1a) (Qal) 建立, 創設, 開始
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) 緊緊坐在一起, 舉行秘密會議 (#詩 2:2; 31:13|)
       1b2) 被建立 (#賽 44:28; 出 9:18|)
   1c) (Piel)
       1c1) 設立
       1c2) 成立, 指定, 命令
   1d) (Pual) 被設立, 被奠基
   1e) (Hophal) 被建立
record.edic_text:
03245 yacad {yaw-sad'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 875; v

AV - foundation 15, lay 8, founded 8, ordain 2, counsel 2, established 2,
     foundation + 03117 1, appointed 1, instructed 1, set 1, sure 1; 42

1) to found, fix, establish, lay foundation
   1a) (Qal) to found, establish, begin
   1b) (Niphal)
       1b1) to fix or seat themselves close together, sit in conclave
       1b2) to be founded
   1c) (Piel)
       1c1) to found
       1c2) to establish, appoint, ordain
   1d) (Pual) to be founded, be laid
   1e) (Hophal) to be founded
